Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, plastic, and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Wood, Plastic, and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 6.5 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

Constructed from durable wood, plastic, and metal materials to ensure a defined appearance and long-lasting use.

Versatile festive accessory that can be easily moved and adjusted to refresh your seasonal arrangement.

Bring a touch of festive charm to your home with these Pink Burgundy Heart Christmas hanging decorations. Designed in a heart shape with a glittering, decorative finish, they add a warm and elegant accent to Christmas trees and seasonal displays. The shimmering detail catches the light beautifully, helping create a magical look that suits traditional festive styling as well as more playful themed décor.

Each ornament includes an attached hanging loop for easy placement on branches, garlands, wreaths, windows, doors, balconies, porches and other decorative spaces. Their lightweight hanging design makes them simple to arrange and remove as needed, so you can refresh your display with minimal effort.

This set is a versatile choice for anyone looking to add a romantic, eye-catching detail to Christmas decorating. The pink and burgundy colour palette works well with gold, silver and other festive tones, while the heart shape offers a softer alternative to classic round baubles. Whether used on a tree or as part of a wider seasonal arrangement, these decorations help create a joyful and polished finish.

Suitable for indoor use and sheltered outdoor styling, they can be reused across seasonal events and celebrations. Their decorative woven look and sparkling finish make them a lovely option for holiday homes, party dressing and themed festive displays. A thoughtful choice for adding a coordinated accent to your Christmas décor scheme.

Attached hanging loop makes each ornament easy to place on branches, garlands, wreaths, doors, windows and more.
Pink and burgundy tones offer a warm, elegant accent that pairs well with classic gold, silver and mixed festive décor.

8956086439925.sourceDescription:
A white velvet tree skirt, 122 cm, with a ruffled hem and tie closure. White under a green tree is the closest thing to snow without a can of fake snow.

The velvet is soft with a low sheen, so it looks bright without shining like satin, and the pleated ruffle gives the hem some weight. Ties at the centre opening keep it round the stand. At 122 cm it suits trees of 6 to 7 ft, and it also works as a base for a winter display on a sideboard. Hand wash cold or spot clean, then dry flat; store rolled so the pleats keep their shape.

Keep it away from muddy boots and mugs of tea, and it will last for years.

Material: Velvet
122 cm white velvet skirt with a ruffled hem
Low-sheen velvet, bright without looking like satin
Ties at the centre opening hold it round the stand
Suits 6 to 7 ft trees or a sideboard display
Hand wash cold, dry flat, store rolled

Christmas Tree Skirt
This Christmas tree skirt adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Textured Grip
The grip surface is designed to reduce unwanted movement in the intended setting. Keeping the contact surfaces clean helps maintain a consistent contact area.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Red. Stated size: 100 x 100 cm. Product weight: 0.254 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to your Christmas display.
Textured grip surface is designed to reduce unwanted movement and keep the skirt securely in place.
Made from durable red polyester construction for a defined appearance that complements home decor.
Generous 100 x 100 cm size provides ample coverage for standard Christmas tree bases.
For Indoor Use

8941467526325.variantName: DIY Felt Christmas Tree 3 ft with 26 Detachable Ornaments Hanging Wall Decoration for Toddlers and Kids
8941467526325.sourceDescription:
Bring the Christmas tree onto the wall with this 3 ft DIY felt set, complete with 26 detachable ornaments including Santa Claus, a snowman, snowflakes, Christmas stockings, a Christmas hat, sweets and bells. It suits family Christmas party decorations at home, in the bedroom, preschool, kindergarten or daycare, and no artistic skill is needed, so children can build their own tree while the whole family joins in.

The tree is made from 3 mm thick felt, and the hook-and-loop fasteners are sewn directly onto it, so the pieces stay firmly in place while children move and rearrange them. That makes it a calm, screen-free activity that keeps little hands busy for 30 minutes or more while you cook dinner, wrap presents or enjoy a coffee.

Recommended for children over 18 months and a good fit for ages 1.5 to 8. Decorating helps hand-eye coordination, fine motor skills and colour recognition, and children under 18 months should play under adult supervision. The set arrives in a gift box, so it is ready to give without extra wrapping.

The tree is designed to be used again every December. It ships folded, so a low-temperature steam iron for about one minute will remove the creases and bring back a smooth shape for hanging on a wall or door. Store it flat in the bag between seasons and bring it out for the next holiday.

Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5056899203225.sourceDescription:
Add a cheerful festive glow to your home with this Wallace and Gromit mirrored LED frame, featuring the much-loved duo wrapped up for winter. Wallace wears a Santa hat and bright red scarf, while Gromit sports cosy earmuffs and a patterned scarf, creating a charming seasonal scene against a reflective backdrop. The dark wood-effect surround gives the display a classic finish that works beautifully with garlands, ornaments and other Christmas decorations. Choose from three illumination settings, natural, warm and cool, to suit your mood or room. The natural option offers a balanced glow, warm creates a cosy golden atmosphere, and cool brings a crisp wintry finish. A convenient touch button on the side makes it easy to switch between the settings without moving the display. Powered by 3 x AA batteries (not included), this decorative picture can sit on a mantelpiece, shelf, sideboard or hallway console without a trailing mains cable. A delightful addition to seasonal home décor, it looks just as inviting switched off as it does glowing on a winter evening.
Featuring Wallace in a festive Santa hat and red scarf alongside Gromit in cosy earmuffs and a patterned scarf, this cheerful winter scene brings familiar character and seasonal charm to home displays.
The reflective mirrored background adds depth to the colourful artwork, while the rich dark wood-effect surround creates a smart, traditional finish that pairs beautifully with garlands, candles and festive ornaments.
Three selectable LED colour tones let you tailor the atmosphere to your setting: natural for balanced illumination, warm for a soft golden glow and cool for a crisp, wintry appearance on darker evenings.
A discreet touch control positioned on the side of the frame makes it simple to change between natural, warm and cool lighting modes, so you can refresh the look of your decoration without lifting or rearranging it.
Battery operation offers flexible placement on shelves, mantelpieces, sideboards and console tables without a trailing mains cable. The decorative display requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not supplied.
Guarantee - 3 months

A pot-grown Noble Fir has a distinctive tiered shape, with well-spaced, sturdy branches that create a naturally full Christmas tree. Its dark green foliage features a subtle blue tinge, while the soft, flat needles give the tree a fuller appearance and make decorating comfortable and easy. The branches are strong enough to hold lights, baubles, and other decorations, while good needle retention helps the tree stay fresh throughout the festive period. A slightly spicy, festive fragrance completes the traditional real Christmas-tree experience without overpowering the room.
DECORATE WITH CONFIDENCE: The sturdy branches of this Noble Fir provide good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations, while the well-spaced tiers leave room to show them off. Its soft, flat foliage is also more comfortable to handle while decorating and won't scratch little hands.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
FRESH, FESTIVE LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Noble Fir has a slightly spicy fragrance that adds a distinctive festive note without being overpowering. Its good needle retention also helps it stay fresh throughout the Christmas period, so the tree continues to look and smell the part as the celebrations unfold.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR THE GARDEN: Once the festive season is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue to care for it as it grows. With their year-round colour, Noble Firs make excellent evergreen trees for garden structure.
VIBRANT POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE TO ENJOY YEAR AFTER YEAR: Bring the Noble Fir indoors again for future Christmases, returning it outdoors afterwards so it can continue to grow. With the right care, you can grow a Christmas tree that becomes a familiar part of your Christmas traditions year after year.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.

Choose 5ft with 1,733 tips and 700 LEDs, 6ft with 2,317 tips and 920 LEDs, or 7ft with 3,189 tips and 1,160 LEDs. Hinged branches make assembly easier before shaping, and a foot control cycles through eight lighting settings, including steady warm white, steady multicolour, fading, flashing and alternating effects. Each size is mains powered for indoor use and comes with a metal stand and plastic storage bag for use after the festive season.

5056141038025.sourceDescription:
Create a festive focal point in your home with this elegant pre-lit artificial Christmas tree. Designed with a snow flocked finish and a mix of tip styles, it delivers a full, natural-looking appearance that brings a luxurious seasonal feel to any room. The green pine effect is enhanced by white snow dusting for a wintry look, making it ideal for year after year use.

This 7ft tree is quick and straightforward to assemble, helping make Christmas preparation easier. It uses a hinged construction, so the branches are attached to the sections for convenient setup and takedown. The tree is made from a high-quality mixed leaf design using PE, PET and PVC materials, and it comes complete with a sturdy metal stand for reliable support.

For added atmosphere, the tree includes 320 cool white LEDs with 8 lighting modes to choose from: waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination. With an approximate diameter of 130cm and 1205 total tips, this pre-lit Christmas tree offers plenty of fullness for decorating. Size is 7ft / 2.1m / 210cm including stand and tree.
Snow flocked finish gives this pre-lit Christmas tree a fresh winter look with various tip styles for a natural appearance.
Hinged branch construction makes assembly and disassembly quick and easy, helping save time when setting up for Christmas.
Made from PE, PET and PVC mixed materials for a lifelike tree shape with a full green pine effect.
Includes 320 cool white LED lights with 8 selectable modes: waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination.
Supplied with a sturdy metal stand and an approximate 130cm diameter for stable display in living rooms or festive event spaces.
Our Trees feature a hinged construction meaning the branches are attached with rivets to the tree making it easier than ever for you to assemble your tree this year.
Each pole has plastic cap to protect in transit. Kindly remove caps prior assembly.
All branches need to be stretched symmetrically when you set up.
